Thomas Cook
What I'd put into the RFP

For a 50-person company, don't compare only the booking fee. Ask each provider for an all-in 12-month quote covering:

Booking/service fee per domestic flight, international flight and hotel.

Cancellation + reissue fee on top of airline charges.

Emergency/night/weekend assistance charges.

Credit period and security deposit.

GST invoice/reconciliation.

Employee travel-policy enforcement.

SLA for urgent cancellation/rebooking.

Refund turnaround.

Exit/termination fees.

Important: I would not pay TwixAir as a managed-TMC provider until it supplies a corporate proposal demonstrating those capabilities. Its publicly visible offering doesn't currently establish that it competes with myBiz, EMTDesk or Thomas Cook's corporate-travel operations.
